violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. A female employee was observed wearing bracelets while she was handling food on the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. Employee removed the jewelry from her hands.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The faucet at the hand washing sink in the women’s restroom is very loose and in need of repair. This faucet needs to be secure in place.
violations.corrective_action: Properly secure faucet at this sink for proper operation.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited in Garbage Rooms
violations.observation: Food storage in garbage rooms. Racks of buns observed stored next to trash containers inside the dry storage room .
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored next top trash containers and mop buckets, to prevent contamination. CDI-CFE relocated the trash containers and the mop bucket away from food and single service utensils, during the inspection.
